tools.name: search_policy
tools.description: Search the endorsement wording - definitions, exclusions table rows, exceptions, limits and duty clauses - with a free-text query, optionally restricted to specific form numbers. Returns wording passages with chunk ids only - it never returns claim facts.

query.description: What to look for in the wording, e.g. 'sewer backup deductible'.
query.title: Query

form_numbers.description: Form numbers to restrict to, e.g. ['HO-0820']. Omit to search all forms.
form_numbers.title: Form Numbers

tools.name: compute_payout
tools.description: Compute the payable amount for a coverage decision already made: min(loss_amount, limit) minus the excess, never below zero; 0 when denied, null when undetermined. Arithmetic only - it never reads the claim or the wording, so pass in the figures you have already found.

loss_amount.description: Dollars of loss the decision applies to.
loss_amount.title: Loss Amount

excess.description: Excess or deductible in dollars that applies to this loss.
excess.title: Excess

limit.description: Per-event limit or sublimit in dollars that caps this loss. Omit if none applies.
limit.title: Limit
